svg.title: ARMs Race 50-level state machine
svg.desc: The challenge consists of 50 completely independent ARM bytecode blocks, each starting with r0 = 0x1337, executing unique operations, and producing a unique result.

g.text: ✓ Each level initializes independently with r0 = 0x1337 (no state inheritance)
✓ Every level has unique ARM operations — 50 distinct bytecodes, no repeats
✓ Each level produces a unique result completely independent of all others
✓ The 50 levels are solved sequentially but NOT chained — each is isolated

svg.text: Blue = input state (0x1337) | Teal = execution | Green/Coral = output
